The Court said Respondent Number 6 will include office bearers of CJP and everybody. Don't insist on that," the Court said. Acting Chief Justice Nitin Wasudeo Sambre, Justice Sanjay Sharma The High Court was hearing a public interest litigation (PIL) filed by one Anil Kumar Gupta. CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke has called on citizens to gather with national flag at Central Park in Connaught Place at 5 pm on October 16 to protest the detention of party leaders Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka. It also alleged that commissions were being demanded for the release of pending payments amounting to over Rs 20,000 crore. The allegations were levelled by RVM Constructions India Limited in a letter to the Builders Association of India (BAI), the apex body of construction companies, seeking their intervention. RVM Constructions managing director Nama Ramesh alleged that the tender process for various projects was manipulated to favour pre-selected bidders. He cited the example of Sushee Infra, which he alleged was disqualified from the bidding process for the Radial Road-2 project using political influence. The letter alleged, “As is widely known, there is a political rift between Shri Rajagopal Reddy and Shri Revanth Reddy. Since Sushee Infra belongs to Shri Rajagopal Reddy's family, it is alleged that the Chief Minister influenced the client to disqualify the company.” “Over the last five to six years, I have observed that at least 10–12 companies typically participate in engineering, procurement, construction/hybrid annuity model projects tendered by the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways, National Highways Authority of India (NHAI), and state governments. In [the three Radial Road-2 packages], however, only four bidders participated, and the remaining bidders are understood to be companies pre-arranged with the Chief Minister Revanth Reddy,” the letter said. The letter alleged that other contractors who intended to bid received threatening calls from the Chief Minister’s Office.
